rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative plural of sahasra, indicating the large number
compound of yoni and yantra in locative plural, denoting ritual or cosmic diagrams
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: What condition of suffering afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand yoni-diagrams?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
items.inference: Beings are subjected to torment throughout the vast array of eighty-four thousand yoni-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and must be inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand yoni-diagrams.
